description: 事物正在消逝，但你注意到了它还在的那一刻
core_questions: 什么东西正在慢慢消失？
approach: 观察正在结束的事物，而不是已经结束的事物
good_output_patterns: catches the moment something still exists before it disappears
reveals what is visible only because it is ending
turns the fact of disappearance into a discovery about presence
changes how the reader values what is still here
